title: Algerian Doraji Tagine
description: A hearty tagine made with tender doraji, fragrant algerian spices, and a hint of pungency from the onions.
instructions: Heat oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced doraji and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the Algerian spice blend, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until doraji is tender.
Garnish with parsley, serve hot over couscous or rice.
Simmer the tagine for 20-25 minutes or until doraji is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over couscous or rice, garnished with parsley.
